BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Sections 3 & 4 of the Societies Ordinance (Chapter 123), I, Rishad Bathiudeen,Minister of Industry, Commerce, Resettlement of Protracted Displaced Persons, Cooperative Development and VocationalTraining & Skill Development do by this Notification.

01. Authorize the purpose for which the Society known as “Seemasahitha Peradiga Wasthuvidya Vidwath Samithiya”situated at Sri Gnanawasa Thripitaka Vidyayathanaya, 1119/3, Sarana Mawatha, Kotte Road, Rajagiriya as apurpose to which the powers and facilities of that Ordinance ought to be extended.
